method: Read-only comparison of frozen project records with exact files from official public Linux, IIO and DT trees plus bounded lore history; no Linux tree retained and no build, VM, private material, device, I2C transaction or upstream contact.

canonical_patch_position.result: canonical position verified at frozen parent; no series or profile changed

public_history.subject: [PATCH v3 1/2] iio: imu: bmi160: add support for bmi120
public_history.relevance: Shows the explicit compatible and chip-ID extension pattern for a related BMI160-family part.

public_history.subject: [PATCH v4 1/3] iio: light: stk3310: relax chipid check warning
public_history.relevance: Documents that unknown compatible STK-family IDs intentionally log informationally and continue; probe success is not exact Gemini identity evidence.

patch_0052.binding_shape: bosch,bmi160, one reg value and an optional nine-string mount-matrix are allowed by the current binding
truthful_parts: one candidate rather than two legacy logical devices
matrix exactly encodes the frozen direction-7 transformation
unproved_parts: VDD and VDDIO rail source and lifetime
INT1/INT2 wiring and electrical mode or confirmed absence
patch_0052.reason_not_upstreamable: The child and parent bus are disabled, the label describes a candidate, the Gemini base DTS is absent upstream, and identity/resources/orientation lack an attributable physical contract.

identity_disposition.safe_probe_boundary: Normal probe is not read-only: it enables vdd/vddio, soft-resets, reads ID, and configures accel/gyro even after unknown-ID warning.

identity_disposition.current_driver: reuse only with a matching explicit compatible
identity_disposition.safe_probe_boundary: Normal probe is not read-only: after reading 0x3e it enables ALS/proximity and proximity interrupt mode even for an unknown ID.

dependency_map.required: Accepted Gemini DTS and enabled, validated I2C1 controller and pins.
One physical BMI-family ID and responding 0x68/0x69 address; separately, exact STK product/revision from ID register 0x3e.
VDD/VDDIO or STK rail source, voltage, sequencing and lifetime owner; distinguish controlled from already-on.
Exact sensor pin, SoC pin, pinmux, polarity, edge/level, drive and wake contract, or explicit no-IRQ decision.
Physical package axes to documented chassis axes and the corresponding IIO matrix.
Standard IIO scale, timestamps and mount-matrix-aware consumption; fusion and legacy compatibility stay in userspace.

verdict.smallest_eventual_upstream_topic: One Gemini BMI160 board-DTS consumer of the existing binding and driver, after the base board is upstream and exact identity, address, rails, IRQ/no-IRQ and physical orientation are attributable.
verdict.next_discriminator: A source-pinned, independently redistributable Gemini BMI160 population/electrical record covering exact part and address, both rails and owners, interrupt wiring/electrical mode or absence, and package-to-chassis axes.
verdict.failure_result: Missing or conflicting attribution retains the stop and admits no node or probe. No I2C action is selected by this review.
verdict.stk3310_order: Separate later topic after exact product/revision, explicit compatible, rail lifetime and GPIO88/EINT11 electrical contract are proved.

bmi160_hardware: matrix-applied static gravity on each chassis axis
described IRQ delivery only if present

upstream.binding_change: Not needed for a genuine BMI160/BMI120 or an explicitly listed STK33xx part.
upstream.authorship: Existing patch author/sign-off metadata was not recertified. The actual author must confirm any future DCO certification; no Tested-by or maintainer agreement exists.
upstream.local_patch_removal_condition: Remove patch 0052 when accepted upstream Gemini DTS covers the same proved identity, address, orientation and resources; retire or replace it immediately if evidence disproves any field.

validation_performed: four frozen parent hashes and sizes
sixteen mainline source hashes and sizes
limitations: No public source reviewed here establishes the Gemini physical BOM or electrical wiring.
The frozen direction-7 translation is internally consistent but not a physical chassis-orientation test.
Bounded public-history searches are not proof that no older discussion exists.
Compilation cannot establish identity, rails, interrupt behavior, scale, axes, orientation or wake behavior.
